estimand.name: area_under_label_yield_curve_in_the_first_six_thirty_seconds_of_endpoint_budget
estimand.population: strictly v11-disjoint senior-0819 train-only verified-direct-sibling residual graph
estimand.oracle_unit: one complete endpoint execution returning one scalar external grade
estimand.label_closure: an unordered sibling pair becomes a training label if and only if both endpoints have been fully executed
estimand.budget_regime: label-scarce only: cumulative endpoint fractions 1/32 through 6/32

population_reconstruction.strict_residual_rule: drop a candidate row if either endpoint or its declared parent appears in the union of v11-b0 endpoints and parents, or if its physical run appears in v11-b0 runs

forbidden_acquisition_inputs: prospective first-960 Target-300 or Target-522 values

methods.uniform_node: order endpoints by sha256(seed,NODE,endpoint); execute in order
methods.uniform_edge: order unordered edges by sha256(seed,EDGE,u,v); execute only missing endpoints and skip already closed edges at zero additional cost
methods.closure_greedy: maximize exact newly closed edges per new endpoint, then gain, then lower cost, then deterministic hash tie-break
methods.balanced_closure_greedy: maximize gain divided by cost*(1+closed edges in task)*(1+closed edges in run), then unpenalized gain per cost, gain, lower cost, and deterministic hash tie-break

primary_comparison.uniform_summary: nearest-rank median plus 5th and 95th percentiles over 256 deterministic randomizations
primary_comparison.greedy_summary: minimum median and maximum over 32 deterministic tie trajectories
primary_comparison.primary_integral: for each trajectory, unweighted sum of six equally spaced cumulative closed-edge checkpoints; a constant-width discrete approximation to yield area up to 6/32

promotion_gates.integrated_yield: minimum over greedy tie trajectories of the six-checkpoint closed-edge sum is at least 6/5 of the nearest-rank median over uniform-edge trajectory sums
promotion_gates.pointwise_consistency: balanced greedy median closed edges strictly exceed uniform-edge median at at least 5 of 6 checkpoints
promotion_gates.terminal_yield: at 6/32, minimum balanced greedy closed edges are at least 11/10 of the uniform-edge median
promotion_gates.terminal_parent_breadth: at 6/32, minimum balanced greedy parent breadth is at least 2/3 of the uniform-edge median
promotion_gates.terminal_task_run_breadth: at 6/32, minimum balanced greedy task and run breadth are each at least 3/4 of the corresponding uniform-edge median
promotion_gates.terminal_anti_dominance: for every balanced tie trajectory at 6/32, maximum single-task share is at most 1/3 and maximum single-run share at most 1/10
